findings: Winner describes four-model final ensemble: ViT, ResNeXt, EfficientNetB4 and CropNet.
Final blend first averages ViT and ResNeXt probabilities, then sums with EfficientNetB4 and CropNet probabilities.
CropNet was used without further fine tuning; center cropping precedes its resizing.
Intake omits two ensemble members and the actual two-stage combination.
Bi-tempered loss, pseudo-labeling and five-fold TTA claims need verification in primary software; not established by the recovered writeup.
next_steps: Locate authors published notebooks, pin code-only cells and establish licenses.
Verify training, augmentation, class alignment and final inference across all four models.

model_specific_findings: ResNeXt uses ordinary cross entropy, while ViT uses bi-tempered loss and EfficientNetB4 uses sigmoid focal loss.
ResNeXt and ViT use distinct preprocessing; EfficientNetB4 has its own patch/TTA averaging.
Writeup lists three training notebooks and one inference notebook, but available extraction did not expose their link destinations.
